why: The only project names a sample, a fixture or a test may use. A name seen in a real account, a real workspace or a real run is never one of them: on 2026-11-12 a customer's project name reached a sample row that way, in a public repository. tests/mod-render/demo-names.test.mjs and backend/core/tests/test_demo_names.py fail on any other name. To use a new one, make it up and add it here.
